text_blocks.snippet: Portugal's annual inflation rate rose to 2.4% in June 2025, according to preliminary estimates, up from 2.3% in May. This is the highest rate since February and is partly due to increased prices for food and non-alcoholic beverages, as well as restaurants and hotels, according to Trading Economics.

list.snippet: Overall Inflation: The annual inflation rate in Portugal rose to 2.4% in June 2025, according to a preliminary estimate by Trading Economics. This is a slight increase from 2.3% in May.
Food Inflation: Food inflation rose to 3.1% in June, up from 2.6% in May.
Other Sectors: Inflation also increased for transportation (1.8% vs. 1%) and restaurants and hotels (6.8% vs. 6.1%).
Housing and Utilities: Inflation slowed for housing and utilities, decreasing to 2.1% from 4.2%.
Harmonized Inflation: The EU-harmonized inflation rate rose to 2.1%, surpassing the European Central Bank's 2% target.
Monthly Change: Consumer prices in Portugal edged up by 0.1% from the previous month.
